cases.note: Proposed numbers measure wire budget only. Indexed/RLE descriptors and palette uploads are included, initial Clear and maintenance replay are excluded for all candidates. Palette entries are 27-bit mode+payload with a 32-bit upload header, at most 7 per frame. RLE chooses the best of six axis orders and uses 1..256 cell runs. Dense decoding still needs native emitter work; no speedup claim for the current Avatar.
